claims.object_text: cell-adhesion molecule of the cadherin superfamily preferentially expressed in the brain
claims.quote: PCDH19 encodes for protocadherin-19 (PCDH19), a cell-adhesion molecule of the cadherin superfamily preferentially expressed in the brain.

claims.object_text: binds the alpha subunits of GABAA receptors, modulating their surface availability and mIPSCs
claims.quote: We recently reported that PCDH19 binds the alpha subunits of GABAA receptors (GABAARs), modulating their surface availability and miniature inhibitory postsynaptic currents (mIPSCs).
PCDH19 downregulation reduces GABAAR-mediated tonic current, evaluated by current shift and baseline noise analysis.
PCDH19 regulates GABAARs kinetics without altering their conductance.
GABAARs of shRNA-expressing neurons preferentially exhibit brief openings at the expense of long ones, thus displaying a flickering behavior.

claims.object_text: increases intrinsic excitability (reduced rheobase; increased AP firing)
claims.quote: PCDH19 downregulation reduces the rheobase and increases the frequency of action potential firing, thus indicating neuronal hyperexcitability.
PCDH19 mutations cause a neurodevelopmental syndrome named epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile, 9 (EIEE9) characterized by seizures associated with cognitive and behavioral deficits.
